title: Replace the PoC with the complete 20-record catalogue artifact
acceptance_criteria: The checked-in catalogue artifact contains exactly the 20 exercises from the dated ODS document with 20 unique deterministic IDs.
Every imported exercise has non-empty normalized type values, category, muscles, specific muscles, steps, instructions, tags, and common-error pairs.
Evidence category, evidence strength, and sources are used only at the import boundary and are absent from exported user-facing Exercise objects.
The three PoC exercises and their module are deleted, and no application or test source references the PoC exports or PoC group.
